source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 1 同主题完形(坚持学骑车/一次失败后再来/团队的力量/演讲前的紧张/把爱好变成本领/帮助他人也是成功)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: Learning to Ride
passages.text: When I was eight, my father tried to teach me to ride a bike, but I was afraid of (1)____. Every time the bike moved, my heart began to (2)____ fast, and I wanted to give up. My father told me that the only way to (3)____ was to keep trying. So each evening after dinner I (4)____ in the small yard behind our house. At first I fell again and again, and my knees were always (5)____. But little by little I learned to keep my balance (6)____. One warm evening, I suddenly felt the bike moving (7)____ under me, and I did not fall. My father stood there, (8)____ at me with pride. That moment taught me an important (9)____: with enough patience, even a hard skill can be learned. Now, whenever something seems too difficult, I remember the day I finally (10)____ my fear of the bike.

passages.title: After the First Failure
passages.text: My first science project was a complete (1)____. I had spent weeks on it, yet on the day of the show my model simply would not (2)____. When the next show came, my model worked, and the judges were (8)____ with it. I learned that one failure is not the end; it is only a (9)____ to do better. questions.explanation: a complete failure 彻底的失败。

passages.title: The Power of a Team
passages.text: People often think that great success is the work of one (1)____ person, but the truth is usually different. Behind almost every famous achievement there is a (2)____ of people working together. When one member feels tired, the others keep him (3)____ with kind words. When a hard problem appears, many minds can (4)____ ideas and find an answer faster than one mind alone. A good leader (5)____ each person's strengths and gives everyone a part to play. That is why even a (6)____ scientist often gives the credit to her whole team instead of (7)____ it for herself. A team that trusts each other can stay (8)____ through difficult times. So if you ever feel that a goal is too (9)____ for you alone, remember that asking others for help is not weakness. Together, ordinary people can (10)____ extraordinary things.

questions.explanation: one single person 单独一个人。
a team of people 一群人/团队。
keep him going 让他坚持下去。
gather ideas 汇集想法。

a modest scientist 谦逊的科学家。

stay strong 保持坚强。
too big for you alone 对你独自太艰巨。

passages.title: Before the Big Speech
passages.text: The night before my first English speech, I could hardly (1)____. I kept imagining the audience (2)____ at me, and my hands felt cold. As I started to speak, I was surprised to find the room quietly (8)____ to me. My voice grew (9)____ with every sentence. on small cards 在小卡片上。

passages.title: Turning a Hobby into a Skill
passages.text: When I was young, drawing was just a (1)____ I did for fun after school. My early pictures were rough, and I almost (2)____ up many times. passages.title: Helping Others Is Success Too
passages.text: Many people think that success only (1)____ being famous or making a lot of money. But my aunt, a village nurse, taught me a different (2)____.
